Defensive.Description: What if you want a character to prepare to dodge or parry a flurry of enemy blows, take a defensive stance in a doorway, or use their Language (Magick) SKILL to dispel a swarm of SPELLS aimed at them? You can choose a SKILL, use an ACTION, and gain a +20 modifier to defense TESTS using the chosen SKILL until the start of your next TURN.

defensiveRemove.Name: "Defending" removed before turn
defensiveRemove.Hint:
Enabled: The "Defending" status will be removed at the start of the actor's turn.
Disabled: The "Defending" status will remain active until manually removed.

defensiveList.Name: Skills for "Defending"
defensiveList.Hint:
Select which skills will be offered for the "Defending" action.
Regardless of the choice, skills will only be displayed if the actor has them. If none of the selected skills are found, all available skills will be offered.
If you want to change the skills selected for the "Custom" option, right-click.

Custom.Name: Custom
Custom.Label: Skill Selection
Custom.Hint:
Specify which skills to display in the "Defending" selection window.
Skills the actor does not have will not be displayed.
If only one skill is specified, it will be automatically selected for the "Defending" action.

Confirm.Label: Change settings?
Confirm.Hint: A custom skill filter is already set. Do you want to change it?

updateNotification.Name: Use new notifications
updateNotification.Hint:
Enabled: all standard notifications will use the new format.
Disabled: only module notifications will use the new format.

translateImportedActors.Name: Translate actor data on import
translateImportedActors.Hint:
Enabled: when importing an actor from a Compendium, you will be prompted to translate their data.
Disabled: actor import from a Compendium will proceed as usual.

Requires the "Babele" module.

enableSounds.Name: Enable Sound Effects
enableSounds.Hint:
Enabled: play sounds during skill checks, in combat, magic, and when handling equipment.
Disabled: module sounds will not be played.

Requires the "WFRP4e - Sounds" module or another compatible one.

soundsVolume.Name: Sound Effects Volume
soundsVolume.Hint: Individual volume multiplier for sound effects.

soundsFunnyMode.Name: "Funny" mode for sounds
soundsFunnyMode.Hint:
Enabled: alternative "funny" sounds will be played if available.
Disabled: only standard sounds will be used.

soundsPath.Name: Path to sounds folder
soundsPath.Hint: Path to the root directory of the module's sound effects.

WFRP4E.greatMaw.descriptions: Whenever an Ogre Butcher successfully casts spells of the Great Maw, the offering they have eaten may restore health. Make a [[/r 1d10]] roll. If the result is 10, or is equal to or exceeds the CN of the cast spell, the Butcher heals wounds equal to the spell's CN.
WFRP4E.little-waaagh.descriptions: The spells of Goblin Shamans (and some Hobgoblins) usually manifest the "Waaagh!" as malicious tricks and hexes. The confidence of Goblin Shamans grows as their spells succeed. If the mage gains additional SL as a result of a Casting Test, they can spend them using Overcasting rules or use them to purchase one Fortune point. Fortune points gained this way can accumulate beyond the maximum limit, but must be spent before the end of combat or they will be lost.
WFRP4E.big-waaagh.descriptions: The spells of the "Big Waaagh!" serve as conduits for massive amounts of "Waaagh!" energy, and releasing it emboldens the hearts of nearby Orcs, Goblins, and Hobgoblins. Whenever a Character casts a "Big Waaagh!" spell, all Orcs, Hobgoblins, and Goblins within Willpower yards lose all @Condition[Broken] conditions.
